title: Burial Customs
summary: Biblical burial customs often involved family tombs, spices, wrapping, mourning, and prompt burial.
background: Understanding burial customs helps readers follow accounts like Abraham’s purchase of a burial place, Lazarus in the tomb, and the burial of Jesus.
teachingHelp: In resurrection passages, background details such as tombs, stones, spices, and mourning help show the reality of death and the power of God over it.
